taiwan_relevance_score.description: How likely this source regularly has Taiwan-related events (0=none, 1=always Taiwan)

feasibility.description: Scraping difficulty: easy=static HTML, medium=JS-rendered or complex pagination, hard=login/API-only

card_selector_hint.description: CSS selector that matches event card/list-item elements

title_selector_hint.description: CSS selector for event title within a card

date_selector_hint.description: CSS selector for event date within a card

date_format_hint.description: Date format string, e.g. YYYY年MM月DD日 or YYYY/MM/DD

detail_link_selector_hint.description: CSS selector for per-card anchor to event detail page

notes.description: Key observations for scraper author: unusual patterns, JS requirements, etc.

taiwan_evidence.description: Taiwan-related text strings found on the page (justifies the score)
